'''''Arabis caucasica''''' is a species of flowering plant in the [[Brassicaceae|mustard family]] (Brassicaceae) known by the common names '''garden arabis''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> '''mountain rock cress''' or '''Caucasian rockcress'''.

==Distribution and habitat==
It is native to Crimea, Turkey, Iran, Caucasus and the Mediterranean.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Arabis caucasica - Plant Finder |url=https://www.missouribotanicalgarden.org/PlantFinder/PlantFinderDetails.aspx?taxonid=278048 |access-date=2023-09-12 |website=www.missouribotanicalgarden.org}}</ref> It grows in crevices of limestone rocks, streams and alpine meadows.<ref name=":0" />

==Description==
''Arabis caucasica'' is an evergreen perennial herb growing up to {{Convert|1|ft|m|abbr=on}} by {{Convert|1.5|ft|m|abbr=on}}.<ref name=":0" /> It flowers in early spring and has white petals.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Arabis caucasica in Flora of North America @ efloras.org |url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=242442306 |access-date=2023-09-13 |website=www.efloras.org}}</ref>

==Cultivation==
It is [[Hardiness (plants)|hardy]] to zones 4-9 and is not frost tender. A popular ornamental garden plant for its early flowers, [[cultivars]] include the pink 'Compinkie'. Under its putative synonym ''A. alpina'' subsp. ''caucasica'', the cultivars 'Flore Pleno' <ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/68086/Arabis-alpina-subsp-caucasica-Flore-Pleno-(d)/Details | title = ''Arabis alpina'' subsp. ''caucasica'' 'Flore Pleno' | publisher = RHS | accessdate = 12 April 2020}}</ref> and 'Schneehaube'<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/112684/Arabis-alpina-subsp-caucasica-Schneehaube/Details | title = ''Arabis alpina'' subsp. ''caucasica'' 'Schneehaube' | publisher = RHS | accessdate = 12 April 2020}}</ref> have gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].
